proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha hab hbc
  have hb : 0 < b := by omega
  have hc : 0 < c := by omega
  constructor
  · intro h
    have haq : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hbq : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hcq : (c : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have eq : b * c + a * c + a * b = a * b * c := by
      field_simp at h
      have : ((b * c + a * c + a * b : ℕ) : ℚ) = ((a * b * c : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
        push_cast; linarith
      exact_mod_cast this
    have ha3 : a ≤ 3 := by
      by_contra hne
      have h4 : 4 ≤ a := by omega
      have hbcpos : 0 < b * c := by positivity
      nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right c hab, Nat.mul_le_mul_right b (le_trans hab hbc), Nat.mul_le_mul_right (b * c) h4]
    interval_cases a
    · nlinarith
    · have hb4 : b ≤ 4 := by
        by_contra hne
        have : 5 ≤ b := by omega
        nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right c this]
      interval_cases b <;> omega
    · have hb3 : b ≤ 3 := by
        by_contra hne
        have : 4 ≤ b := by omega
        nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right c this]
      interval_cases b
      omega
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩) <;> norm_num
